answer: Witnessed Delay Ledger.** Each identity needs k independent witnesses to countersign its registration, and witnesses are drawn from a rotating pool seeded by the ocean of prior transaction timestamps. A vine of referrals must root in a witness who has already spent real elapsed time in the system. Witnesses forfeit their ivory reputation credits if the identity they sign later defects. Cost to an attacker: recruiting k distinct witnesses per clone, each risking accumulated credits, so scaling requires genuine social surface, not money.
